description: This PHP class defines the EmployeeOnLeaveDao which manages data access related to employees on leave in the OrangeHRM system. It provides methods to retrieve a list of employees currently on leave based on search filter parameters, as well as counting the total number of such employees. The class leverages Doctrine ORM's query builder for constructing database queries and is part of the OrangeHRM Dashboard plugin's DAO layer.

classes.name: EmployeeOnLeaveDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class for Employee Leave data, providing methods to fetch and count employees currently on leave based on specific search criteria.

methods.name: getEmployeeOnLeaveList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of employees on leave matching the provided search filters.

methods.name: getLeaveListPaginator
methods.description: Constructs and returns a paginator object for leave records based on the search filters, including the necessary joins and filtering conditions.

methods.name: getEmployeeOnLeaveCount
methods.description: Returns the count of employees on leave matching the given search criteria.
